title: pvTextureMaptoPlane
body:
## pvTextureMaptoPlane

Adds 2-D texture coordinates (point array "Texture Coordinates") by projecting each point onto a plane. In automatic mode (ParaView default, used while Origin and Point1 are both [0, 0, 0]) a least-squares plane is fitted and s and t run from 0 to 1 across the projected bounds. Otherwise s is the projection of (point − Origin) on Point1 − Origin, divided by that edge's squared length, and t likewise with Point2, so s and t are 0 at Origin and 1 at Point1 or Point2. Use it to drape an image (e.g. a photograph or map) on a flat or gently curved surface; pvTextureMaptoCylinder suits round parts.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- While Automatic is true the explicit points are used only if Origin or Point1 is non-zero, and Point2 alone is ignored; set Automatic to false whenever you give the points.
- Automatic mode needs at least three points; smaller inputs get no texture coordinates.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TextureMaptoPlane`. Identity: `filters/TextureMapToPlane`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Automatic` | If set the plane values will be automatically generated. Note that for this to work all the Origin, Point1 and Point2 must all be set to zero. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Origin` | This property specifies the 3D coordinates for the origin of the plane. Set all to zero if you want to use automatic generation. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Point1` | This property specifies the 3D coordinates for Point1 of the plane. Set all to zero if you want to use automatic generation. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Point2` | This property specifies the 3D coordinates for Point2 of the plane. Set all to zero if you want to use automatic generation. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
